root_causes.current_behavior: OpenAlex works set quoted_text=title and still emit EvidenceCard.
root_causes.expected_behavior: OpenAlex/Crossref records are METADATA_ONLY discovery, never fact evidence.
root_causes.minimum_fix: Mark metadata-only and exclude from agent catalog / fact support.

root_causes.current_behavior: Crossref DOI hits use title as quoted_text.
root_causes.expected_behavior: Crossref records remain METADATA_ONLY until OA fulltext is fetched.
root_causes.minimum_fix: Do not convert Crossref metadata into eligible EvidenceCard.

root_causes.line_function: literature_to_evidence_card quoted = abstract or summary or title
root_causes.current_behavior: Missing abstract falls back to title as quote.
root_causes.expected_behavior: Title fallback yields METADATA_ONLY, not a fact card.

root_causes.line_function: module docstring and search(); ArxivClient.search does not download PDF
root_causes.current_behavior: Open literature explicitly does not download PDFs; DOI landing pages stay metadata.
root_causes.expected_behavior: OA PDF/XML/HTML is fetched, validated, parsed, and quoted with locator.
root_causes.minimum_fix: Add OA fulltext chain and only FULLTEXT/ABSTRACT verified cards enter the bundle.

root_causes.line_function: EvidenceCard has no locator field; empty locator still eligible
root_causes.current_behavior: Cards without page/section/paragraph still enter the catalog.
root_causes.expected_behavior: Fact-eligible cards require a stable locator and content hash.

root_causes.current_behavior: Metadata OpenAlex/Crossref IDs are sent to HypothesisGenerator as citable IDs.
root_causes.expected_behavior: Prompt sees only allowed_evidence_ids from the eligible bundle.

root_causes.line_function: BaseAgent.run collects IDs but does not reject unknown IDs before later gates
root_causes.current_behavior: Unknown IDs such as Q028_booklet survive until quality_gates.check_evidence_grounding.
root_causes.expected_behavior: Parser/ID guard fails closed immediately; no fuzzy rewrite.

root_causes.line_function: HYPOTHESIS_GENERATOR_PROMPT does not list allowed IDs or forbid Q028_booklet
root_causes.current_behavior: Q028_booklet is not a fixture; the model freely invented it. Not an ID repairer.
root_causes.expected_behavior: Prompt lists allowed IDs and forbids question-source IDs; parser rejects the rest.
root_causes.minimum_fix: Prompt + parse-time guard. Do not mint Q028_booklet.

root_causes.current_behavior: Metadata sources are typed as paper inside EvidenceBundle.
root_causes.expected_behavior: Discovery metadata stays ineligible; only verified quotes become paper cards.
root_causes.minimum_fix: Do not map metadata-only API hits to paper eligibility.

answers.openalex_to_card: OpenAlexClient.search quoted_text=title, then OpenLiteratureRetriever.search via literature_to_evidence_card
answers.why_not_rejected_at_parse: BaseAgent.run collected IDs for tracing but did not compare them to allowed_evidence_ids
